18e30e73: The built-in system prompt requires the model to preserve HTML / Markdown tags and attributes, and not modify link `href`, image `src`, `id`, or `class`. The content of the `prompt` field is appended after it and can be used to add custom requirements such as a glossary or tone.
9e4db204: When the model request fails (network error, insufficient balance, etc.), that paragraph falls back to rendering the original text, and **is not written to the cache**; the next build will retry the translation and will not permanently persist the failed result.
2f97713f: Translation-related caches are all in the `.kecare/cache` directory:
384e3774:
- `translations/<lang>/<标题哈希>/translations.json`: Paragraph-level translation cache, keyed by the hash of the paragraph content. When a paragraph in an article is changed, only that paragraph is retranslated.
- `markdown-manifest.json`: Article-level cache that records the hash of the source content and the generated pages. When an article is unchanged and all artifacts are present, the build skips parsing and translation entirely; if an artifact file is deleted, the page is rebuilt using cached data.
487d259f: `kecare clean` cleans generated artifacts and article-level caches, but keeps the paragraph translations under `translations`. To completely reset all caches, just delete the `.kecare/cache` directory.
fafc7b54: Language codes follow the BCP 47 standard's `语言-地区` format, such as `en-GB` and `pt-BR`; the region part must be uppercase.
